info.title: Samva API
info.description: Samva is a developer email API for product teams: deliverability, versioned templates, inbound threading, and signed webhooks behind one typed send call.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of messages across all channels, with optional filters for channel, status, conversation, contact, and date range.

anyOf.description: Optional org-scoped key that makes a send idempotent. Repeating a request with the same key and identical payload replays the original 201 response; reusing the key with different content returns 409.

post.description: Sends a message on the requested channel and returns the created message with a 201 Created status. `channel` selects the payload variant. Repeating an identical request with the same optional `Idempotency-Key` header returns the original message; reusing the key for different content returns a conflict.

get.description: Returns a single message by its ID.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a message by its ID.

get.description: Returns email delivery details for a message, optionally including signed URLs for its raw MIME, HTML, and text content.
Returns the current delivery status of a message by its ID.
Returns the list of delivery events recorded for a message.
Lists durable asynchronous operation state for the active organization.
Returns one durable asynchronous operation from the active organization.

post.description: Retries the same durable execution identity when its failure is explicitly retryable. Retrying a workspace deletion additionally requires `organization:delete`.
Schedules a message at the absolute ISO-8601 instant in scheduledFor. Optional timezone is validated IANA display metadata only and never changes the execution instant.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of scheduled messages, optionally filtered by status.
Returns a single scheduled message by its ID.

post.description: Cancels a pending scheduled message so it will not be sent, and returns the updated scheduled message.
Creates an email campaign draft for the given audience and content, returning the created campaign.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the organization's campaigns, optionally filtered by status.
Returns a single campaign, including its content, audience, and policy, by its identifier.

patch.description: Updates the name, content, audience, or policy of a campaign draft.

delete.description: Archives a draft campaign so it can no longer be scheduled, returning the archived campaign.

post.description: Schedules an email campaign run at the absolute ISO-8601 instant in scheduledFor, or immediately when omitted. The optional idempotencyKey is scoped to the organization and replays return the original run.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of runs for a campaign, optionally filtered by status.
Returns a single run of a campaign by its identifier.

post.description: Pauses an in-progress campaign run and returns the updated run.
Resumes a paused campaign run and returns the updated run.
Best-effort cancellation: pending recipients are skipped, while already claimed or provider-submitted deliveries may finish. Returns the updated run.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of recipients for a campaign run, optionally filtered by status.
Returns the organization's default open and click tracking policy. Each field is independent and defaults to enabled. Recipient opt-out takes precedence over these defaults.

patch.description: Updates one or both organization email tracking defaults and returns the complete saved policy. Recipient opt-out still takes precedence.

get.description: Returns the organization-scoped tracking opt-out for a normalized recipient email. A missing preference reads as opted in and is not created.

patch.description: Opts a normalized recipient email in or out of open and click tracking. Opt-out takes precedence over per-send overrides and organization defaults without changing suppression or send eligibility.

post.description: Registers a domain for sending and returns it with the DNS records required to verify ownership and configure DKIM. Responds with 201.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the organization's sending domains.
Returns the stored DNS and provider lifecycle snapshot without calling a provider or mutating state.

post.description: Observes the required DNS records and, once they match, idempotently starts provider provisioning for the staged domain.

get.description: Returns a single sending domain, including its DNS records and verification details.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a sending domain from the organization.

post.description: Looks up the domain's nameservers to detect its DNS registrar and returns the provider, nameservers, and a link to its setup docs.

get.description: Reports whether the domain's DNS provider supports Domain Connect one-click setup for Samva, and the provider's name when it does. Ineligible is a normal result — the manual DNS records remain the way to verify.

post.description: Builds the signed Domain Connect apply URL for the selected sending-only or sending-and-receiving service. Manual DNS remains available for either mode.
post.summary: Build a one-click DNS apply URL

post.description: Consumes the Domain Connect provider's redirect. Validates the signed state and, when the records were applied, kicks verification. Returns applied, cancelled (the customer declined), or invalid (state failed validation).

Enables inbound receiving for a verified domain by creating a receipt rule, and returns the rule name and its recipient addresses. Set `catchAll` to route every address on the domain; that requires a webhook endpoint, supplied as `endpointId` or already configured on the domain.
post.summary: Enable inbound email for a domain

post.description: Marks a verified domain as the organization's default sending domain, atomically clearing any previous default. Omitted-`from` sends resolve through the default domain's default sender.

put.description: Sets the default sender used for omitted-`from` sends from this domain. The sender must belong to the domain and be verified and active.

delete.description: Removes the domain's default sender so omitted-`from` sends fall through to the organization default sender.

patch.description: Overrides the domain's open/click tracking, reply-to, and unsubscribe-group defaults for the settings cascade. An omitted field is left unchanged; null clears it back to the organization default. Returns the saved config.

post.description: Provisions a custom tracking domain (default label `track`) for a verified sending domain so open/click links redirect through the customer's own subdomain. Requires the custom_tracking_domain entitlement. Returns the resulting state including the two DNS records the customer must create.

get.description: Returns the custom tracking state for a sending domain: lifecycle status, the required DNS records, certificate and CAA readiness, and any scheduled teardown. `enabled` is false when no custom tracking domain is provisioned.

delete.description: Tears down a domain's custom tracking and its managed resources. Sends immediately revert to the shared tracking host. Existing custom links in already-delivered mail stop working.

get.description: Reports whether the domain's DNS provider supports Domain Connect for its current Custom Tracking Domain. Ineligible is a normal result and the exact manual CNAME records remain available.
get.summary: Check automatic Custom Tracking Domain setup eligibility

post.description: Builds the signed Domain Connect URL for the current customer-selected tracking host. The server derives the host and Cloudflare DCV UUID; exact manual CNAME records remain available.
post.summary: Build an automatic Custom Tracking Domain apply URL

post.description: Validates the purpose- and revision-bound registrar state, then re-kicks the existing readiness reconciliation. The callback never declares the host ready or changes email tracking selection.
post.summary: Complete an automatic Custom Tracking Domain return

post.description: Durably creates a sender identity. The required Idempotency-Key replays the original sender for an identical request and conflicts when reused with different input.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of sender identities, optionally filtered by verification status, active state, or default flag.
Returns the current verification status of a sender identity.

delete.description: Accepts sender removal, marks it inactive, and retains its deleting lifecycle until provider identity and association cleanup is confirmed.

post.description: Marks a verified, active sender as the organization default, atomically clearing any previous default. Used for omitted-`from` sends when no default domain sender applies.

get.description: Returns aggregate email statistics — sent, delivered, bounced, and complained counts with their rates — optionally scoped to a date range.

post.description: Enables catch-all inbound receiving for a domain by creating a receipt rule, and returns the rule name. `endpointId` is one of the organization's webhook endpoints; every address on the domain delivers `message.received` to it. Responds with 201.
Disables catch-all inbound receiving for a domain.

patch.description: Updates a domain's catch-all receiving configuration: the webhook endpoint that receives its inbound mail.

get.description: Returns the catch-all receiving configuration for a domain, including the webhook endpoint that receives its inbound mail and its email counts.
Returns catch-all receiving counters for a domain, adding an aggregated breakdown when a date range is supplied.
Returns the addresses this workspace will not send to, newest first, optionally filtered by suppression type, active or expired state, and an address substring, with limit and offset paging.

delete.description: Deletes a suppression so this workspace can send to the address again. When the engine mirrored the address into the sending provider's suppression list, that entry is lifted first, and the deletion fails rather than reporting success if the provider refuses, so the operation stays retryable. The provider entry is left in place when another workspace still reports the same address as bouncing or complaining, because that list is shared with every workspace; the response does not say which case applied. Deliverability caveat: a bounce or complaint suppression records a real delivery failure, and sending to the address again risks the reputation damage the suppression prevented.

post.description: Blocks an email address or domain from inbound receiving and returns the created block entry. Responds with 201.

get.description: Returns block entries, optionally filtered by block type and active state, with limit and offset paging.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a block entry, unblocking the associated address or domain.

patch.description: Updates a block entry's reason, notes, active state, or expiry.

get.description: Returns a log of inbound emails that were blocked, optionally filtered by block entry, sender, or date range.

post.description: Checks whether an email address is currently blocked and returns the matching block rule when one applies.
post.summary: Check whether an address is blocked

post.description: Creates an inbound email forwarding rule and returns it. Responds with 201.

get.description: Returns inbound email forwarding rules, optionally filtered by domain and active state, with limit and offset paging.

patch.description: Updates an inbound email forwarding rule and returns its current summary.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an inbound email forwarding rule.

get.description: Returns a log of forwarded inbound emails with their delivery outcomes, optionally filtered by rule, status, or date range.
Returns safe provider authorization metadata and owner-scoped DNS grants. Credentials are never returned.

post.description: Validates and encrypts a Cloudflare or Vercel token, then creates an organization-owned grant. Session administrators only.
Proves that an existing organization-owned provider authorization manages this domain, then extends its domain grant without repeating provider authentication. Session administrators only.
post.summary: Reuse a connected DNS provider account

post.description: Creates a one-time provider authorization continuation and returns its consent URL. Session administrators only.
Consumes a one-time Cloudflare OAuth or Vercel Integration callback and creates the organization binding. Session administrators only.
Builds a server-owned, 15-minute DNS plan from the domain's current requirements and provider state without mutating DNS.
Records digest-bound consent for all or an explicit subset of the plan operations.
Claims the plan lease, re-reads provider state, applies the digest-bound operations, and persists an immutable receipt.
Builds a deletion plan only from provider records proven by the latest automatic setup receipt.
Records separate digest-bound consent for destructive DNS operations.
Re-reads every approved record and deletes only provider record IDs proven by the original create receipt.

delete.description: Removes this organization's binding and revokes the shared provider authorization only after its final binding is detached. Session administrators only.

post.description: Creates the media object in the pending state and returns it with the upload instruction — URL, method, and headers — for putting its bytes into storage.
Verifies the uploaded object exists in storage, marks the media object ready, and returns it with a download URL.

delete.description: Deletes a pending media object and the bytes stored for it. Fails if the media object is already ready.

get.description: Returns the media object's metadata, including status, dimensions, and confirmation timestamps.
Generates a presigned, time-limited download URL for a ready media object.
Returns a paginated list of conversations for the organization, filterable by status, channel, contact, and date range.

post.description: Creates a new conversation with its initial contacts and returns it with a 201 status.

get.description: Returns a single conversation by its ID.

patch.description: Updates an existing conversation's fields and returns the updated conversation.

get.description: Returns the messages in a conversation using the canonical message schema and page-based pagination.

post.description: Attaches one or more contacts to a conversation and returns the updated conversation.

delete.description: Detaches one or more contacts from a conversation and returns the updated conversation.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of contacts for the organization, filterable by search term, type, status, and date range.

post.description: Creates a new contact and returns it with a 201 status.
Samva API operation.
Returns an existing contact matching the given identifiers, or creates a new one when none exists.

get.description: Returns a single contact by its ID.

patch.description: Updates an existing contact's fields and returns the updated contact.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a contact by its ID.

get.description: Returns aggregated engagement metrics for a contact, including message counts and active conversation totals.

post.description: Creates or updates contacts in bulk from a list, returning per-entry results with created, updated, skipped, and error counts.
Permanently deletes multiple contacts by ID, returning counts of deleted and failed records.
Adds, removes, or replaces tags on multiple contacts in one request, returning counts of updated and failed records.
Sets the status on multiple contacts in one request, returning counts of updated and failed records.
Exports contacts as JSON or CSV, returning the serialized data and a count of exported records.

get.description: Returns a paginated timeline of a contact's message activity, optionally filtered by channel.
Returns the contact groups that a contact currently belongs to.
Returns a paginated list of the organization's templates, filterable by category, channel, status, and search, with configurable sorting.

post.description: Creates a template from SML source; the source's root tag determines the template's channel. Returns the created template with status 201.

get.description: Returns a paginated dashboard view that groups related channel templates into families and leaves standalone templates ungrouped.
Returns a paginated list of the organization's template families and members.

post.description: Creates an empty template family with the supplied name and returns it with status 201.

get.description: Returns a template family and its channel-specific member templates.

patch.description: Changes a template family's name and returns the updated family.

delete.description: Deletes a template family without deleting its member templates.

post.description: Creates a template family containing the specified template and returns the new family with status 201.
post.summary: Create a family from a template

post.description: Adds an existing template as a channel member of the family and returns the updated family.
post.summary: Attach a template to a family

delete.description: Removes a member template from the family without deleting the template.
delete.summary: Detach a template from a family

post.description: Creates a template for the requested channel in the family and returns the updated family with status 201.
post.summary: Add a channel to a template family

get.description: Returns template metadata and compiled channel content. Read live SML through the template-document API.

patch.description: Updates template metadata. Source changes use the template-document revision API.

delete.description: Deletes a template from the organization and returns a success flag.

post.description: Records compliance approval for a template with optional notes and moves its status to approved unless it is already published or archived.
Creates or loads the authoritative editable document for a template and returns its current snapshot.

get.description: Returns the current authoritative source, revision, and metadata for a template document.

post.description: Authorizes a bounded template-agent operation against the current document and returns the admission context.
Records completion of an admitted agent conversation-clear operation for the template document.
Applies an admitted agent-authored source proposal when its revision and source digest still match the document.
Replaces the editable SML source when the expected revision matches and returns the updated document snapshot.
Materializes the specified document revision as a durable template source version and returns its receipt.
Renders the specified document revision with optional variables and reports any missing variables.
Renders and analyzes the specified document revision for spam risks, returning issues and recommendations.
post.summary: Check a template document for spam

post.description: Renders the specified document revision and sends a test message to one recipient without publishing it.
Sends or schedules the specified document revision for one or more recipients with optional variables.

get.description: Returns the saved source-version history for a template document.

post.description: Publishes the current saved template source version and returns its lifecycle receipt.
Unpublishes the current template source version and returns its lifecycle receipt.
Restores a saved source version into the editable document when the expected revision matches.

get.description: Returns the organization's configured email design kit (theme, assets, footer), or null when none is set.

put.description: Validates and saves the organization's email design kit; a null body clears the design back to the base design floor.

post.description: Creates a webhook endpoint subscribed to the given event types and returns it with a 201 response.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the organization's webhook endpoints, optionally filtered by a name search.
Returns the configuration of the webhook endpoint with the given ID.

patch.description: Updates a webhook's name, URL, subscribed events, channels, custom headers, or status and returns the updated endpoint.

delete.description: Deletes a webhook endpoint so it no longer receives event deliveries.

post.description: Queues a signed webhook.test event through the normal delivery and retry lifecycle.

get.description: Returns recent deliveries and their nested attempt diagnostics for a webhook endpoint.
Returns aggregate pending, delivered, exhausted, and cancelled delivery counts for a webhook endpoint.

post.description: Performs one immediate manual redelivery attempt and returns that attempt's identity and outcome without changing the automatic retry lifecycle.
Generates and returns a new signing secret. The previous secret remains valid for a 24-hour rotation overlap.
Creates a new workspace organization under the current billing account and returns it.

get.description: Returns the organization for the current billing account.

patch.description: Updates the current organization's profile, billing, locale, design, default reply-to, and default unsubscribe-group fields and returns the saved organization.

get.description: Returns usage statistics for the current organization over the selected reporting period.

post.description: Accepts owner-authorized durable workspace deletion. Repeating the same request with the same Idempotency-Key returns the existing organization-scoped operation.
Creates a replacement first workspace under the signed-in user's billing account when no workspace membership remains.
Creates a new API key for the organization and returns the created key, including the plaintext secret, with a 201 response.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the organization's API keys, filterable by status and search term.
Returns the API key with the given ID, including its metadata and permissions.

patch.description: Updates the name or description of an API key and returns the updated key.

delete.description: Deactivates an API key so it can no longer authenticate requests. The key record is retained and remains listable.

post.description: Issues a replacement with the same owner, name, and permissions, then deactivates the existing key. Returns the new key, including the plaintext secret.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an API key record. Unlike revocation, the key row is removed rather than deactivated.

get.description: Returns aggregate send counts and daily volume attributed to an API key over the selected period of 7, 30, or 90 days.
Returns a paginated list of recent request activity recorded for an API key.

opens.description: Override open tracking for this send. Omit to inherit the organization default. A recipient tracking opt-out always disables tracking.

clicks.description: Override click tracking for this send. Omit to inherit the organization default. A recipient tracking opt-out always disables tracking.

EmailTrackingOverrideV1.description: Requested per-send engagement tracking policy. Recipient opt-out takes precedence, then explicit fields, organization defaults, and product defaults.
